title: docs(adr): ADR-0066's viewAllFields vote anchor names holdsViewAllFields
body:
Refs #37245 (one item: the symbol anchor at ADR-0066 line 146, the anchor half of the row added in comment 7178404228)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；只改了权限设计记录里的一句话，把它指向代码的位置换成一个在「字段权限拆分」最后一步合并前后都存在的位置。
- 为什么做：属于「字段权限拆分」专题；最后一步那个改动会删掉这句话原来指向的位置，它自己的文档检查因此一直是红的，这次先把这一句改好给它让路。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这句话读起来不如原来直白，只有读这份设计记录的人会碰到；纯文档，可以直接撤回，不影响任何功能。
- 要你做什么：请审这一句并亲手合并（设计记录须由你本人合）。

## What changes

One sentence of one dated note in `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`: the note of 2026-11-24 under D2 ⑧, line 146. Nothing else in the file moves.

Before:

```text
The vote is cast inside `superuserFieldVote` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts#superuserFieldVote`), so both field merges answer the same.
```

After:

```text
The vote is cast inside the one function that calls `holdsViewAllFields` (`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts#holdsViewAllFields`), and both field merges call that function, so both field merges answer the same.
```

The anchor now names `holdsViewAllFields`, the predicate that reads the `viewAllFields` bit. The sentence describes the vote function by its relation to that predicate and no longer by its name.

## Why

- Draft pull request #37371 (card #36055, the last step of the field-axis split) replaces `superuserFieldVote` with `viewAllFieldsReadVote`. Line 146 is the only symbol anchor in `docs/adr/**` that names the removed function, so `check:adr-symbol-anchors` is red on that branch with exactly this one finding.
- The replacement function is not on `main` until #37371 merges. An anchor to it would be red on `main` today, so this pull request cannot use it.
- `holdsViewAllFields` is declared in that file on both trees, with the same body. The liveness ledger already cites it as the evidence for the `viewAllFields` key (`packages/spec/liveness/permission.json`).
- The reworded sentence is true on both trees. On `main` the one function that calls the predicate is `superuserFieldVote`. On #37371 it is `viewAllFieldsReadVote`. On both, `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` and `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` call that function once per field.
- This is the anchor half of one row of the weekly ADR revisions card. The other half of that row, the D2 ⑧ end-state note, waits for #37371 to merge. Every other row of the card stays with its own claimer.

### Read first

1. `docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md`, line 146. It is the only hunk. The risk is in the rewording: the sentence must read true against the code on both trees.
2. `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, not changed here: `holdsViewAllFields` and its single call site. The call site sits in `superuserFieldVote` on `main` and in `viewAllFieldsReadVote` on #37371.

### Two-minute check

Run `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors` on this branch. Expect exit 0 and a line that starts `✅ check-adr-symbol-anchors: 4237 anchors across 163 records resolve`.

For the other tree: check out the head of #37371, run `git merge --no-commit` with this branch, then run the same command. Expect the same line. Without the merge, that head exits 1 and prints one finding, `[unresolved-symbol] docs/adr/0066-unified-authorization-model.md:146`.

## Tests

Docs only. No package is touched, so no build closure and no package test is owed. No tested behaviour changed, so there is no ablation.

The before and after of the gate on the tree of #37371 is the reverse verification. Three heads of that branch were read, because it moved twice during this work. Each merge was a throwaway in a scratch worktree, never committed and never pushed; the worktrees are removed.

| Tree | `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` |
|:---|:---|
| This branch, `edbee340d4` (on `main` at `58570d8002`) | exit 0, 4237 anchors resolve |
| The #37371 branch at `bad558d574`, as pushed | exit 1, one finding at ADR-0066 line 146 |
| `bad558d574` with this branch merged in | exit 0, 4237 anchors resolve |
| The #37371 branch at `ecc008621e`, as pushed | exit 1, the same one finding |
| `ecc008621e` with this branch merged in | exit 0, 4237 anchors resolve |
| The #37371 branch at `71a5990508`, as pushed | exit 1, the same one finding |
| `71a5990508` with this branch merged in | exit 0, 4237 anchors resolve |

All three merges were clean, with no conflicted path. The gate's `--self-test` exits 0 on this branch and on each merged tree.

<details><summary>How each symbol answers the gate's own resolver, per tree</summary>

`symbolResolutionClass` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`, asked with the text of `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts` at each commit:

| Commit | `holdsViewAllFields` | `superuserFieldVote` | `viewAllFieldsReadVote` |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `58570d8002` (`main`) | declaration | declaration | absent |
| `edbee340d4` (this branch) | declaration | declaration | absent |
| `bad558d574` (the split's branch) | declaration | absent | declaration |
| `71a5990508` (the split's branch, latest) | declaration | absent | declaration |

</details>

<details><summary>What the reworded sentence claims, counted on each tree</summary>

- Call sites of `holdsViewAllFields` in `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`, comments aside: one on `58570d8002` (line 1076, inside `superuserFieldVote`) and one on `bad558d574` (line 1064, inside `viewAllFieldsReadVote`). The function is not exported, so nothing outside the file calls it. `packages/lint` keeps a separate author-time copy under the same name; the anchor names the file, so it does not point there.
- Callers of that one function among the two field merges. On `58570d8002`: `buildEffectiveFieldPermissions` (line 1175) and `getFieldPermissions` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts`, line 590). On `bad558d574`: lines 1160 and 566 of the same two files.
- The file is byte-identical between `bad558d574`, `ecc008621e` and `71a5990508`, so the second reading stands for all three.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The end-state note is not written here.** The same row asks for a dated note stating what is true once View All and Modify All stop voting on fields. That note is written after #37371 merges, as the card says of every row whose prerequisite has not merged.
- **Sentences this pull request leaves alone.** The notes of 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-15, and the rest of the 2026-11-24 note, say that View All and Modify All vote on fields. The first two each name `superuserFieldVote` once in prose (lines 142 and 144). All of that is true on `main` today. It becomes dated when #37371 merges, and the end-state note is what supersedes it. The gate passes on those two mentions on both trees: it judges anchors, and a name in prose is not one.
- **Why not the symbol the row proposed.** The row comment proposes re-pointing at `viewAllFieldsReadVote`. That holds only after #37371 merges. This pull request has to be green on `main` alone and has to leave that branch green once it merges `main`.
- **An edit, not an added note.** Re-pointing an anchor changes the sentence that carries it, so this is a one-sentence rewrite inside an existing dated note. No decision text is touched.
- **No changeset.** The diff is `docs/adr/**` alone, which no package ships. `skip-changeset` is declared with this pull request.
- **Governed path.** `docs/adr/**` lands by the maintainer's hand. This pull request stays a draft and nobody is asked to review it from here.
- **Order of landing.** This one lands first. The #37371 branch then needs one merge of `main` to pick the sentence up, and its anchor gate reads green from that commit on.
- **The generated index is untouched.** `pnpm check:adr-index` exits 0 at this head.
- **The protocol line.** The claim spells it as n/a, docs only. It is written above in the closed vocabulary as `none`, which is what that says.
- **Base.** The branch is cut from `main` at `58570d8002`. `main` has since moved by one commit, `54d6726c09`. It changes a changeset, a CLI test and two files of `packages/lint`, and nothing under `docs/adr`, in the anchored file or in the gate.

## Verification
